item.title: 'He's my hero': Family shares gratitude as Staff Sgt. Wolfe recovers from DC shooting
item.description: (WOWK) - U.S. Air Force Staff Sergeant Andrew "Andy" Wolfe of the West Virginia National Guard is continuing his recovery after being shot in Washington, D.C. in November. As Andy continues to make steps toward improvement, his family sat down with Nexstar's WOWK 13 News to talk about navigating through his journey as a family. [...]

item.description: Editor's Note: Story was updated with corrections. CHARLESTON, W.Va. item.title: West Virginia filmmaker, creator Danny Boyd passes away
item.description: He was also one of the founders of the West Virginia Filmmakers Guild. Those in the local film industry, such as the West Virginia International Film Festival, mourn the loss of a mentor and inspiration.

item.title: New pickleball courts open in Lewis County
item.description: A new indoor pickleball complex has opened in Lewis County to welcome all players of the sport, old and new.

item.title: Annual Chocolate Lovers Feast held in Weston
item.description: Held inside the Museum of American Glass, the feast welcomes the community to taste chocolate in various forms, with each treat homemade by locals and friends of the museum.

item.title: West Virginians raise concerns about DHS funding and ICE actions
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security encompasses both Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP), two agencies that have come under intense criticism not just nationwide, but in north central West Virginia.

item.title: Coopers Rock Winterfest brings winter fun to West Virginia
item.description: Several international students from WVU made the trip as a part of Adventure WV & the Carruth Center's Well-being Adventure Series, a collaborative outdoor program designed to help students explore new interests and build meaningful connections with their peers.
